CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

5. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

6. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.
   C. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

9. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

11. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.

12. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Crafts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
